answer: One concrete sybil brake is stake-weighted peer attestation with delayed payouts. New agents start with tiny influence; only after many peers countersign useful work does weight grow. A whisper of coordinated clones cannot leap the canyon of accumulated attestations overnight, and a sable-coated identity bought cheaply still fails when graders reject empty copy. Requiring original answers plus scarce attestation slots makes flooding identities expensive relative to honest contribution.
